objective: Al terminar respondes preguntas típicas de una entrevista de trabajo: tu experiencia, tus puntos fuertes y tu disponibilidad.

warmup.prompt_es: Entrevista de trabajo en inglés: ¿cómo hablas de ti mismo, de lo que sabes hacer y de lo que quieres aprender?

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Thank you for coming. Please sit down. Can you tell me a little about yourself?
lines.es: Gracias por venir. Por favor, siéntese. ¿Puede contarme un poco sobre usted?

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Of course. My name is Laura. I studied tourism at university and I worked as a receptionist for two years.
lines.es: Por supuesto. Me llamo Laura. Estudié turismo en la universidad y trabajé como recepcionista durante dos años.

lines.speaker: Interviewer
lines.text: Why do you want this job?

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: I love meeting people and I'm good at solving problems. I'd like to learn more about the hotel business.
lines.es: Me encanta conocer gente y soy buena para resolver problemas. Me gustaría aprender más sobre el negocio hotelero.

lines.speaker: Laura
lines.text: Yes, I can. I don't mind working on Saturdays.
lines.es: Sí, puedo. No me molesta trabajar los sábados.

glossary.example: I have a job interview tomorrow.
I have two years of experience.
I don't mind working at weekends.
I enjoy working in a team.
I'd like to apply for this job.

md_es: | *Can you tell me about yourself?* | *I studied … and I worked as … for two years.* (pasado simple) |
| *Why do you want this job?* | *I love … and I'm good at … I'd like to learn …* |
| *What are your strengths?* | *I'm organised and I work well in a team.* |
| *Can you work at weekends?* | *Yes, I can. I don't mind working on Saturdays.* |
| *When can you start?* | *I can start next Monday.* |
- **be good at + sustantivo / -ing** → *I'm good at maths. · I'm good at solving problems.*
- **I don't mind + -ing** → *I don't mind working late.*
- **I'd like to + verbo** → *I'd like to learn more.*
- **Experience:** *I have two years' experience. · I worked as a waiter for two years.* (*for* + duración, pasado simple)
**Consejos:** *Thank you for the opportunity. · It was nice to meet you.* · Respuestas cortas y claras, con ejemplos.

common_mistakes_es.right: I worked there for two years.
